name: Gwenpool

abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Reduce Defensive AA: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Plot Armor
Gwenpool's read enough comics to know that the main character doesn't die, preventing her from losing more than [90 - 52]% of her current health per hit from Special Attacks. She also reduces her opponent's Defensive Ability Accuracy, based on her current combo count.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: 3% chance to Stun per Bleed active on target, lasting for 0.75 seconds.
30% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [9,819.87] Direct Damage over 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: If target isn't Bleeding when the last strike hits, it has a 5% Chance to cause Bleed, doing [9,819.87] Direct Damage over 6 seconds.
If target is already Bleeding, the attack instead gains a 100% chance to convert one existing Bleed into a Bleed causing [52,795] Direct Damage, over 27 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: This attack Incinerates the enemy, dealing [12,142.85] Energy Damage over 14 seconds. This effect also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50% while it's active.
When this effect expires, it has a 100% chance to consume 1 Bleed effect to reapply itself.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to inflict an Enervate Debuff, preventing the opponent from gaining Power when struck for 7 seconds.
When this effect expires, it has a 100% chance to consume 1 Bleed effect to reapply itself.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, removing 1 Armor Up Buff and reducing Armor Rating by 8,250 for 16 seconds.
When this effect expires, it has a 100% chance to consume 1 Bleed effect to reapply itself.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Plot Armor
content: Gwenpool's read enough comics to know that the main character doesn't die, preventing her from losing more than [90 - 52]% of her current health per hit from Special Attacks. She also reduces her opponent's Defensive Ability Accuracy, based on her current combo count.
